sources.text: Return only active records.
Return records in ascending numeric score order.
Return exactly one eligible record.
Among equal highest scores, return the earliest input record.
When the mode argument is omitted, use normal mode.
An omitted value returns zero; an explicit null returns null.
Lowercase ASCII letters before returning the supplied name.
Store the supplied value durably across restart.
On close, change an open record to closed.
Repeating close on a closed record succeeds without further state changes.
Reject a negative amount with error NEGATIVE.
If a write fails, retain the entire previous durable value.
Accept only calls received strictly before the deadline.
A record keeps the same public identifier after restart.
Emit the public accepted event before the public completed event.
Emit exactly one public event for each successful call.
Return all records in any order; consumers may not depend on returned order.
Return the sum for integer inputs. Noninteger input behavior is explicitly unspecified.
Return the best record.
Return exactly one record. Return exactly two records for the same call.
Every returned record is active. Exactly one record is returned.
Return the supplied integer. This feature is called Lantern in the planning notes.
At most one record is admitted. Return all admitted records in any order.
